name: print-page
description: Render HTML-based printables to PDF with Chromium.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bunx --bun --no-install tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
